in_marathi.name: Shivanand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Grace, God in Us
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shiva + Anand: Shiva (God of Destruction, Creation, and Renewal) + Anand (Bliss, Joy, or Supreme Happiness). The name represents the belief that the divine spirit (Shiva) exists within all beings, granting them the eternal bliss (Anand).

The name represents the belief that the divine spirit (Shiva) exists within all beings, granting them the eternal bliss (Anand).

vedic_reference.note: Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction, is considered the supreme being in Shaivism, one of the major branches of Hinduism. Anand means bliss. Shivanand is a name that signifies the union of the god Shiva and the supreme state of bliss.
